name: Integer Bresenham Voxelization with 6-Connectivity
definition: A voxelization algorithm based on Bresenham's line algorithm, modified to support 6-connected voxel lines and handle negative coordinate differences, used to fill the interior of triangles in integer-based scanline voxelization.
summary: Integer Bresenham Voxelization with 6-Connectivity generates a strictly face-sharing voxel sequence, solving standard algorithm connectivity gaps by explicitly handling multiple voxel outputs per iteration.
